themes.title: pywaggle Camera() zero-arg raises a misleading TypeError
themes.canonical_claim: Calling pywaggle's `Camera()` with no argument raises `TypeError: expected string or bytes-like object, got 'int'` (not a missing-camera error) because the default `device=0` is an int that `Camera.__init__` feeds straight into `re.match`; always pass a device STRING (`"file://example.jpg"`, an RTSP URL, or a data-shim name).
themes.baseline_conflict: camera-rtsp-patterns.md documents the device-routing chain but not that the zero-arg default crashes with a type error rather than a graceful device-open failure.
themes.promote_rationale: Most common first-plugin stumble; the symptom points at `re`, not at the camera.
themes.notes: Pairs naturally with T09 and the no-camera-attached invariant on one offline-dev page.

themes.title: Camp blades ship with no camera and are SGT-scoped
themes.canonical_claim: Camp Thor blades ship with NO camera attached — no `/dev/video*`, empty `v4l2-ctl --list-devices`, no `/run/waggle/data-config.json`, an empty `"sensors": []` in the node manifest, and no port-554 host on either node subnet — so `Camera()`, `Camera("bottom_camera")` and any RTSP plugin will fail until hardware is physically added and registered; probe those five things before writing camera code.
alt_phrasings: Camp Thor nodes are tagged to project SGT, and `auth.sagecontinuum.org/manifests/<VSN>` and `/api/v-beta/nodes/<VSN>` return EMPTY bodies for them, so 'what sensors does my node have?' must be answered on-node: read the `wes-identity` ConfigMap to map hardware serial to VSN, then read `/etc/waggle/node-manifest-v2.json` (host path, needs sudo) or its `waggle-node-manifest-v2-*` ConfigMap copy, which on a bare Thor devkit legitimately shows `"sensors": []`.

`curl` against `auth.sagecontinuum.org/manifests/<vsn>` without `-L` returns HTTP 301 with an EMPTY body, which reads as 'node not found / node down' — the endpoint redirects and needs `curl -sL`, so a bare curl is a false-negative generator when probing node existence.

A node that is missing from the portal's 'all nodes' list is usually not broken but filtered out by project scope — the fleet catalog carries six distinct `project` values (SAGE, SGT, APIARY, VTO, DAWN, Wildebeest) plus ~11 untagged nodes, and the portal defaults to SAGE-scoped; confirm with `GET /manifests/<vsn>` (HTTP 200 + a phase/project) and a `-30d` data-API query before treating it as an outage.
themes.baseline_conflict: auth-api-manifests-and-nodes.md presents the manifest endpoint as the camp default and never says it returns empty for SGT-project nodes.
themes.promote_rationale: All baseline camera guidance assumes an attached Reolink. Confirmed independently on three nodes. Includes the curl -L 301-empty-body false negative and project-scoped portal visibility (a healthy node in another project reads as an outage).
